say:1:1430133101:0.text: Yeah, all my turkeys ran away.
say:1:1430133101:0.source_cn: 是的，因为我家的火鸡又跑掉了。

say:2:1430133102:0.text: They always run around the northern hills when I'm not looking. When my daughter and I try getting close, they run farther away.
say:2:1430133102:0.source_cn: 它们总是趁我不注意跑到北边的山坡上，我和女儿四处找它们...

say:3:1430133103:0.text: When my husband was at home, the turkeys would follow his orders. Maybe they just miss him too.
say:3:1430133103:0.source_cn: 以前我丈夫在家的时候，火鸡很听他的话，也许它们也想他了吧。
